name: Pick and place
definition: Pick up one or more objects and place or move them to a specified destination, including discarding them in a trash or recycling receptacle and orienting them as specified.

name: Clean and place
definition: Wash, rinse, or wet an object at a sink and then place it at the specified destination, if one is specified.

name: Heat and place
definition: Heat, warm, or cook an object in or on a heating appliance, such as a microwave or coffee maker, and then place it at the specified destination (or leave it in/on the appliance).

name: Cool and place
definition: Cool or chill an object in a refrigerator or freezer and then place it at the specified destination, including leaving it in the refrigerator or freezer or removing it.

name: Fill and place
definition: Fill a container with water at a sink and then place it at the specified destination.

name: Lamp interaction
definition: Toggle a lamp or light on if needed, and pick up or hold an object, if one is specified, to illuminate or inspect the object.
